name: p4-900-promotion-matrix-20260912
status: planned; local screen is not leaderboard evidence
objective: Promote only a CaseVO-LLM public-API policy with reliable evidence beyond the current 761.9467 leaderboard submission.

controls.policy: public_greedy with step LLM candidate selection

screens.rule: Candidate generation and legality checks remain Python-side; each selected action is chosen by an AgentBase LLM call with deterministic validated-candidate fallback.

screens.seed_policy: fresh server sessions; generated seed payload hash and variant order fixed before the run
screens.constraint: Use only official public APIs; the runner, never submission code, calls trigger_eval.

promotion_gate.local: For each non-control candidate: zero failures; no negative topology-family mean on independent or holdout blocks; 10,000-resample seed-block paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0.
promotion_gate.remote: Same gate on official terminal scores, then submit exactly one promoted ZIP. A leaderboard score >900 is the final objective evidence; local scores are never converted to leaderboard points.
promotion_gate.LLM: Every submitted AgentBase role must make the configured final-selection LLM call. Count timeout, exception and malformed-output attempts against quota; fallback selects only a prevalidated candidate.
